description: This file is a shell script that contains a set of tests for Git log and fsck functionality, particularly focusing on handling corrupt or malformed commit data. It uses testing functions like test_expect_success, and manipulates Git objects and references to simulate errors and verify Git's behavior.

methods.name: munge_author_date
methods.description: A helper function that rewrites a commit's author date to a specified value, creating a new commit object with potentially malformed date data for testing purposes.
